name: Illusion Mastery (Item Mastery, Mythic)
body:
Your magic items can create complex and lasting illusions.

Prerequisite(s): Illusion Mastery.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional daily use of Illusion Mastery for every odd mythic tier you possess. By expending mythic power, you can force the item to cast a higher-level illusion (figment) spell. This spell may have a level equal to 3 + 1 for every use of mythic power spent.
